title: The FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus: harmonising 128 aviation-safety source codes into one deduplicated cross-national accident dataset
abstract: arXiv:2610.37671v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: National aviation-investigation databases are deep but territorial; global compilations such as the Aviation Safety Network and the Bureau of Aircraft Accidents Archives are hand-curated, apply their own inclusion thresholds, and publish no field-level lineage. The FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus harmonizes 279,485 occurrences and 131,882 attached narratives from 128 source codes - national accident-investigation authorities, occurrence-reporting systems and four global compilations. Records are mapped into one schema; apart from a duplicate pre-filter on three sources, each normalized record reduces to exactly one key from an ordered ladder - event signature, registration and date, rounded position and date, or source and native identifier - so a missing field never creates a link, and the key is the occurrence identifier. translated_title: FlightFinder 事件语料库：将128个航空安全数据源整合为一个去重的跨国事故数据集
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.37671v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：各国的航空调查数据库内容深入但仅限本国范围；而航空安全网络和飞机事故档案馆等全球汇编则是人工整理的，采用各自的事故收录标准，且不发布字段级别的数据来源信息。FlightFinder 事件语料库整合了来自128个数据源的279,485起事件和131,882份附随叙述——涵盖国家事故调查机构、事件报告系统以及四个全球汇编。所有记录被映射到统一的模式中；除了对三个来源进行预先去重过滤外，每条规范化记录都恰好归约为有序键阶梯中的一个键——事件签名、注册号与日期、四舍五入的位置与日期、或来源与原生标识符——因此缺失字段绝不会产生错误关联，且该键即为事件标识符。键阶梯无法匹配的记录则在分块处理中通过评分方式归入一个显式合并表，并仅在（该表内应用）。
tldr: 该论文构建了FlightFinder事件语料库，通过统一数据模式和有序键阶梯去重机制，将来自128个数据源的279,485起航空事件整合为一个可追溯、可去重的跨国事故数据集。
en_tdlr: The paper presents the FlightFinder Occurrence Corpus, which harmonizes 279,485 aviation occurrences and 131,882 narratives from 128 source codes into a single deduplicated cross-national dataset via a unified schema and an ordered key-ladder deduplication mechanism.
